*Rationale: Vapour pressure is inversely related to the strength of intermolecular forces. $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_3$ (propane) is a non-polar alkane whose molecules are held together only by weak London (dispersion) forces. Substances with the weakest intermolecular forces evaporate most readily and therefore have the highest vapour pressure.*
